# Lumii Advisory

> Lumii Advisory is a founder-led AI enablement business in Sydney, Australia, led by Agata Adamczak. Lumii runs practical AI courses for businesses (Find Your Light with AI), hands-on AI workshops and team training for offsites, and AI keynotes and panel talks, with AI advisory and AI visibility services for businesses that need deeper support. Its work is built on the Lumii AI Operating System. Agata has nearly 20 years across data, digital strategy, search and AI visibility, including senior roles at Botify (first ANZ hire; Solutions Consulting Director, JAPAC), Dotdigital, BrightEdge, Pattern, Performics and iCrossing.

## AI courses, workshops, keynotes and enablement

- [AI courses for businesses — Find Your Light with AI](https://lumiiadvisory.com/ai-courses): Lumii's AI course series for business teams, led by Agata Adamczak in Sydney. Three stages: see the opportunity, apply AI to real work, build confident habits for checking outputs and protecting information. Shaped around marketing, sales, retail, professional services and other teams.
- [AI workshops and team training for offsites](https://lumiiadvisory.com/ai-workshops): Hands-on AI workshops built into a team offsite or training day. The team works through real briefs, questions what AI produces and leaves with next steps. Includes the practical session "Stop Prompting. Start Briefing."
- [AI keynote speaker — Agata Adamczak](https://lumiiadvisory.com/ai-keynote-speaker): AI keynotes and panel talks for conferences, offsites and events. Four topics: Find Your Brand's Light in the Age of AI; AI at Work: What Changes on Monday?; The AI-Ready Organisation; Stop Prompting. Start Briefing.
- [AI enablement consultant, Sydney](https://lumiiadvisory.com/ai-enablement): What AI enablement is (building organisational capability to use AI effectively — between AI strategy and AI tools), its four parts (use cases, tools, training, governance), and how Lumii delivers it through courses, workshops and advisory.
- [Ways to work together](https://lumiiadvisory.com/work-with-us): Courses, keynotes and offsite workshops, plus AI advisory for readiness, workflow design and adoption.

Pricing: every course, workshop and talk is scoped first, with a fixed price confirmed after an initial conversation. Lumii is based in Sydney and works with teams across Australia and the Asia-Pacific.

## The Lumii Framework

- [The Lumii AI Operating System & Approach](https://lumiiadvisory.com/ai-operating-system): Five components — Thesis, Guardrails, Workflows, People, Measurement — that give AI a place in the way a business works, and the Lumii method for putting it into practice: Illuminate, Align, Activate, Accelerate. Includes FAQ

## About

- [About Agata Adamczak](https://lumiiadvisory.com/about): Founder biography and career background. Brands worked with in previous roles (not Lumii clients): Harvey Norman, Optus, Canva, Myer, Medibank, OFX
- [Contact](https://lumiiadvisory.com/contact): Enquiries about courses, speaking, offsite training, AI visibility and advisory

## Advisory

- [AI Visibility & Brand Entity Optimisation](https://lumiiadvisory.com/services/ai-visibility): How often and how accurately a brand appears in answers generated by ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. Three layers — AI Visibility Audit, Brand Entity Optimisation, AI Visibility Reporting. Lumii measures and improves AI presence and share-of-voice; it does not sell or guarantee rankings in AI answers.

## AI training for teams

- [Training for your team](https://lumiiadvisory.com/who-we-help): Find Your Light with AI training shaped around the roles and workflows in a business
- [Marketing & growth teams](https://lumiiadvisory.com/who-we-help/marketers): Research with a question, create with a clear brief, understand AI discovery
- [Sales & commercial teams](https://lumiiadvisory.com/who-we-help/sales-teams): Account research, meeting preparation and useful follow-up, with clear boundaries for customer information
- [Retail & ecommerce teams](https://lumiiadvisory.com/who-we-help/retailers): Product content, customer questions and preparing for AI discovery
- [Professional services teams](https://lumiiadvisory.com/who-we-help/professional-services): Research with evidence, draft with judgement, and turn individual experiments into team habits

## Other industries

- [Financial Services & FinTech](https://lumiiadvisory.com/who-we-help/financial-services): Comprehensive AI use-case guide for Australian banks, super funds, wealth managers and FinTechs. Covers five high-ROI use cases — customer onboarding/KYC, fraud and AML, credit decisioning, customer service augmentation, compliance reporting — with proof points, APRA expectations, and a 6-question FAQ on AI in regulated financial services
- [Other industries](https://lumiiadvisory.com/who-we-help#other-industries): Lumii also runs AI training for real estate, hospitality, healthcare and allied health, startups and scale-ups, and education and training providers, shaped around the work each team does

## Resources

- [AI Readiness Diagnostic](https://lumiiadvisory.com/resources/ai-readiness-checklist): Free 35-question assessment across 7 dimensions — commercial clarity, use case discipline, execution ownership, data, technology, capability, and governance. Returns a scored maturity band (AI Unaware, AI Aware, AI Active, AI Leader) and prioritised next-step guidance
- [AI Tools Directory](https://lumiiadvisory.com/resources/ai-tools): 60+ AI tools organised by category — writing, video, coding, research, meetings, data — with pricing and direct links
- [AI Team Structure Guide](https://lumiiadvisory.com/resources/ai-team-structure): Every role explained — CAIO, AI Architect, AI Product Manager, Prompt Engineer — when to hire, who owns what, and the 5-year roadmap
- [AI adoption, analysed](https://lumiiadvisory.com/ai-case-studies): Agata's analysis of publicly documented AI programmes (industry examples, not Lumii clients) from Klarna, Goldman Sachs, Microsoft, Walmart, Morgan Stanley, Duolingo, IBM, and Coca-Cola
- [FAQ](https://lumiiadvisory.com/faq): Honest answers on AI consulting costs, timelines, data privacy, and process

## AI Platform Guides

- [All AI Platform Guides](https://lumiiadvisory.com/learn): Honest, plain-English guides to the major AI platforms
- [ChatGPT for Business](https://lumiiadvisory.com/learn/openai): GPT-5, o3, DALL-E, Custom GPTs, Operator, ChatGPT Enterprise — use cases, pricing, and setup
- [Claude AI for Business](https://lumiiadvisory.com/learn/claude): Claude Sonnet 4.5, Opus 4.5, Claude Code, Claude Design, Projects, Agent SDK, MCP — long documents, careful reasoning, and code
- [Google Gemini for Business](https://lumiiadvisory.com/learn/gemini): Gemini 2.5 Pro, NotebookLM, Deep Research, Workspace integration — multimodal use cases and Workspace integration
- [Microsoft Copilot for Business](https://lumiiadvisory.com/learn/microsoft-copilot): 365 Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI — what it costs, where it pays back, and which tier
- [Perplexity AI for Business](https://lumiiadvisory.com/learn/perplexity): Deep Research, Spaces, Pages, Sonar — research and competitive intelligence

## Insights

- [Codex vs Claude Code vs OpenHands: AI Coding Agents Compared](https://lumiiadvisory.com/insights/ai-coding-agents-compared): Strengths, weaknesses, and business fit for the three leading AI coding agents — cloud-based Codex, local-CLI Claude Code, and open-source self-hostable OpenHands
- [Shadow AI: The Mid-Market Governance Crisis](https://lumiiadvisory.com/insights/shadow-ai-mid-market): Why employees are already using AI you don't know about, why bans backfire, and the 5-part governance framework — sanctioned tool list, data classification, training, monitoring, incident response
- [ChatGPT vs Claude for Business](https://lumiiadvisory.com/insights/chatgpt-vs-claude-business): Honest comparison — where each platform genuinely wins and how to pick
- [Microsoft Copilot vs ChatGPT Enterprise for Mid-Market](https://lumiiadvisory.com/insights/copilot-vs-chatgpt-enterprise): Embedded vs standalone AI, pricing maths, and the dual-deployment pattern that actually works
- [Google Gemini vs Microsoft Copilot for Workspace Teams](https://lumiiadvisory.com/insights/gemini-vs-copilot-workspace): Mirror products on different stacks — and why the answer is usually the AI in the suite you already run
- [AI Workshops vs Sprints vs Retainers](https://lumiiadvisory.com/insights/ai-engagement-models-compared): Which AI engagement model fits your stage — workshops for alignment, sprints for delivery, retainers for ongoing capability
- [The New AI Org Chart: Roles Being Hired Right Now](https://lumiiadvisory.com/insights/emerging-ai-roles-future): CAIO, AI Architect, AI Product Manager, Prompt Engineer — 8 new roles forward-thinking businesses are hiring for now
- [The AI Readiness Gap: Why 78% of AI Pilots Stall](https://lumiiadvisory.com/insights/ai-readiness-gap): The five gaps that block scale and how mid-market leaders close them
- [5 Questions Every CEO Should Ask Before Investing in AI](https://lumiiadvisory.com/insights/ceo-questions-ai-investment): The framework for CEOs and boards before signing the AI budget
- [How to Build an AI Business Case Your Board Will Approve](https://lumiiadvisory.com/insights/ai-business-case-board): The six-part template that speaks the board's language — risk, return, accountability
- [The Hidden Cost of Delayed AI Adoption](https://lumiiadvisory.com/insights/cost-of-delayed-ai-adoption): How to quantify what 12 months of "wait and see" actually costs your business
- [AI in Professional Services: 6 High-Value Use Cases](https://lumiiadvisory.com/insights/ai-professional-services): Where law firms, consultancies, and accountancies should start with AI
- [Data Readiness for AI: A Practical Guide for Mid-Market](https://lumiiadvisory.com/insights/data-readiness-ai): The diagnostic, the fix, and the order of operations for getting data AI-ready
